title: Write the missing how-tos for features that already exist, and add a 'How to read this' header to every analyzer section
why: Many existing features have no how-to: the analyzer has one paragraph, and the game page, builds, practice, pairing, desktop app, import, backups, opponents and reviews have nothing.
spec:
Articles to write (category/slug): getting-started/{install-and-pair, browser-import}; desktop-app/{desktop-app-overview, replay-folders}; analyzer/{today, analyzer-filters, opponents, strategies, trends, macro, maps, builds, replays, arcade, reading-the-charts}. Each analyzer article covers what the section answers, how to drill in, and its sample-size cues. Also: game-page/{game-page, game-page-replay, game-page-accurate-playback}; opponents/opponent-dossier; builds/{custom-builds, rules-explained (worked examples: proxies, 'At most 0', deadlines), build-check-in (ported), practice-ghost-build, randomizer, publish-community-builds}; account-data/{backups-and-export, delete-account, public-profile, player-channels}; stream-studio/{voice, obs-auto-scene-switching}, linking to /stream-studio/learn rather than copying it; troubleshooting/{my-game-didnt-show-up, a-page-asked-me-to-sign-in}. Fix stale copy: 'download from the home page' should link /download; the OBS step about creating a token should say it is auto-created. Note that every number is computed from replays with fixed rules, never AI.
UI: components/analyzer/SectionHeader.tsx (built on ui/PageHeader) is rendered by SectionPanel and OpponentsRoute. It shows the title, the tabs.ts description, a 'How to read this' HelpLink and an actions slot.
Tests: every TABS id has a matching help article; every HelpLink slug exists.
augments:
[analyzer-home/in-section-help] (1) Each section can hide the SectionHeader description (tabs.ts:33-40) with 'Hide intro'. The choice is remembered with useLocalStorageState('analyzer.intro.hidden.<tabId>'), and the 'How to read this' link brings the intro back. (2) Until map-veto-planner ships, remove or soften the 'map stats and veto help' claim in apps/web/components/analyzer/settings/SettingsHelp.tsx (~L108-117) and the 'Map-veto help' line in apps/web/components/landing/LandingPageContent.tsx:463. Restore both, pointing at the maps article, when it lands. (3) Give each analyzer article stable section anchors (Today, Opponents, Strategies, Trends, Macro, Maps, Builds, Replays, Filters) for later InfoTips to link to. The per-control '?' popovers for Net MMR, MMR impact, Min games, too-short and the patch presets come from glossary-and-infotip (W5), which should add an optional info slot to components/ui/SortableTh.tsx for column headers and link each tip to these anchors.

[opponents/opponents-help-and-jargon] Article content. analyzer/opponents (the /app/opponents SectionHeader 'How to read this' target; add legacyAnchors ['opponents']) covers: what the list shows; 'Group same player' (SC2Pulse-linked accounts merged); MMR impact, Net MMR and 'verified pairs' (game-time MMR from consecutive ranked 1v1 replay pairs); Pulse ID vs toon. opponents/opponent-dossier covers: how to fix an unresolved Pulse ID (Retry in 'Data looks wrong?'); notes and read-aloud (Voice → Scouting Report); the barcode identity workflow; what the public community profile shows (k-anonymity, at least 5 contributors). Cross-link the two articles. Terminology: 'dossier' for /app/opponents/[id] and 'public profile' for /community/opponents/[id]. opponents-polish-2 replaces 'deep dive' (OpponentsTab.tsx:333) in the list, and dossier-upgrade replaces 'opponent profile'/'community profile' (ProfileView.tsx:266, 305). title: Today: KPI cards that update live, today's W-L record, and a Default tab that stops redirecting away from Today
spec:
Two visible Today bugs plus some polish on the KPI strip. Files: apps/web/components/analyzer/DashboardKpiStrip.tsx, apps/web/app/app/loading.tsx, apps/web/app/app/layout.tsx, apps/web/components/dashboard/TodayView.tsx, apps/web/components/dashboard/AnalyzerFrame.tsx, apps/web/app/app/page.tsx.

A. KPI cards that update live (today-kpis-live-session-record)
1. Append `#${dbRev}` to the three keys that lack it: globalSeries `/v1/timeseries${globalSeriesQuery}` (~L158), streak `/v1/streak${streakQuery}` (~L200) and wrSeries `/v1/timeseries${wrQuery}` (~L204). This matches selectedRangeSeries (~L177), so all cards refresh on games:changed, as Ladder Pulse already does. Leave /v1/me/mmr unkeyed, because it calls SC2Pulse once per Pulse ID.
2. Error states: replace the placeholder logic (~L212-214). Loading shows '—'. An error with no data shows '—' as the value and a hint button, "Couldn't load · Retry", that calls that query's mutate() with aria-busy while it revalidates. A real zero still shows '0'. Use the compact RequestError from data-states-recovery if it has landed; otherwise use a local button.
3. Session record: rename the lead card from 'Games today' to "Today's session". The value reads '6 games' and the hint reads '4W 2L', taken from today's Period.wins/losses in the same globalSeries bucket (Period in apps/web/lib/timeseries.ts already has both fields). With zero games the value is '0 games' and the hint is 'No games yet today'. This replaces the 'Keep the streak alive' hint, which was wrong during a losing run. sessions (W6) later swaps this card for a real 'This session' card, so keep its data-testid stable.
4. Grid: five cards in grid-cols-2 leave an orphan card on phones. Give the lead card `col-span-2 lg:col-span-1` (phone rows become lead, then 2, then 2), drop the redundant `sm:grid-cols-2` (~L218), and copy the same classes into the skeletons in app/app/loading.tsx:10 and app/app/layout.tsx:72 so nothing shifts on load.
5. Turn the MMR empty hint (~L472) into a Link, 'Add a Pulse ID in Settings', pointing to /settings?tab=profile#pulse-id-help. The anchor already exists in SettingsProfile.tsx, and settings-quickwins makes #anchors scroll.
6. Win-rate timeframe menu (role=menu, ~L339-383): the trigger gets aria-haspopup='menu' and aria-expanded. On open, focus the selected menuitem, or the first one. ArrowUp/ArrowDown wrap, Home/End jump, and Enter/Space select. Escape and Tab close the menu, and Escape returns focus to the trigger. Keep global-filter-clarity's 'all time' labelling if it has landed.

B. Default tab only applies when the session starts on /app (default-tab-redirect-bounce)
1. AnalyzerFrame: on the first mount of any /app route, set a session cookie `sc2_app_session=1; Path=/; SameSite=Lax` with no Max-Age, so it ends with the browser session. Wrap the write in try/catch.
2. app/app/page.tsx (server), after the existing ?opponent and ?tab redirects: if the cookie is absent, read the preference with apiFetch('/v1/me/preferences/misc') using a short timeout, where any failure falls through to Today. When isTabId(pref) and pref is not Today, call redirect(hrefForTab(pref)). The default tab then applies only when /app is the first analyzer page of the browser session, and there is no flash because the redirect runs before render. Clicking Today later always shows Today, since the RSC request carries the cookie. Opening a bookmark such as /app/maps first and then clicking Today also shows Today.
3. Delete the client redirect in TodayView (the useEffect, its /v1/me/preferences/misc fetch, the redirected ref and DEFAULT_TAB_APPLIED_KEY, ~L20-58) and update the doc comment. This also removes one request from Today, and the 'storage blocked = bounce every visit' fallback goes with it.
4. settings-quickwins (W1) adds the 'Today (default)' option to the picker. If this pack lands first, add that option to SettingsMisc's select instead. A stored 'today' value means no redirect.
5. shareable-views (W3) later adds 'Set as default view'. It must plug into this server redirect, not reintroduce a client-side one.
Edge cases: a prefetch of /app from the rail runs page.tsx with the cookie already set. ?tab= and ?opponent= keep priority. If cookies are blocked the user cannot stay signed in anyway, so the cookie is safe to rely on.

Tests (vitest/RTL): a useApi mock records keys; the timeseries and streak keys end with #<dbRev> and change when dbRev bumps. A 500 on streak renders '—', and Retry calls mutate. The hint reads '4W 2L' from a fixture. The lead card has col-span-2. The MMR hint is a link with the right href. Menu keyboard: ArrowDown moves focus, and Escape closes the menu and focuses the trigger. page.tsx: no cookie with pref 'maps' calls redirect('/app/maps'); with the cookie present it renders TodayView; a throwing pref fetch renders TodayView; ?tab wins. AnalyzerFrame sets the cookie on mount. TodayView never calls router.replace.
audit_findings:
- Keep Today's KPI cards live, show today's W-L session record, and tidy the strip (bug)
- Fix the 'Default tab' preference bouncing users away from Today when they click it (bug)

Add one line saying 'Default tab' only applies when you first open the dashboard in a browser session, and clicking Today always shows Today. Add another line saying the session card shows today's games and W-L and updates as games land. Repeat the default-tab line in the Preferences entry of the settings-overview article.

title: Opponents list stays on screen: no skeleton on new replays, rows stream in, readable errors with retry, smooth search
spec:
Goal: a streamer's Opponents table never blanks when a replay lands, the first rows appear after one round trip, failures are readable and retryable, and search stays responsive with thousands of opponents.

1) apps/web/lib/useApiPaginated.ts
- Split requestKey into an identity key [userId, path, pageLimit, maxPages] and the dbRev revision.
- Revalidation (same identity, only dbRev changed): do NOT call setState(emptyState(requestKey, true)) (:83). Keep items and set a new isRefreshing:true while isLoading stays false. Collect all pages into a local buffer and swap them in with one setState at the end, so the table never shrinks to page 1 mid-refresh. Relax the mismatch guard (:148-150) so items for the same identity keep returning while refreshing.
- Account safety: any userId change (sign-out, account switch) still returns emptyState immediately. Never render another account's rows.
- Cold load (no items yet for this identity, including a filter/path change): publish after each page. isLoading is true only until the first page arrives. A new isLoadingMore stays true while later pages load. pagesFetched and hitMaxPages are set on the final page. A path change still clears (rows from another filter would mislead), but page 1 now shows quickly.
- If dbRev changes again mid-refresh, abort the in-flight loop (existing AbortController) and restart. Never run two loops at once.
- Errors: never throw the raw body (:100-102). Parse JSON {error:{code,message}} into a ClientApiError-shaped object {status, code, message} (type from lib/clientApi.ts) with friendly copy. 401: 'Your session expired. Sign in again.' 503 or *_busy: 'The server is busy. Try again in a moment.' A fetch TypeError (code network_unavailable): 'Can't reach SC2 Tools. Check your connection.' Other errors: 'We couldn't load your opponents.' Keep the original code for RequestError.
- A failed revalidation keeps the previous items and sets error plus isStale:true.
- Expose retry(), which bumps an internal attempt counter in the effect deps.
- Return type gains isRefreshing, isLoadingMore, isStale and retry. Update the mock in components/analyzer/__tests__/OpponentsTab.mmrImpact.test.tsx.

2) apps/web/components/analyzer/OpponentsTab.tsx: states
- showSkeleton stays isLoading && rawItems.length === 0 (:261).
- The count line (aria-live=polite) shows 'Updating…' with a small spinner while isRefreshing, and 'Loading more opponents… (1,000 so far)' while isLoadingMore.
- While isLoadingMore, the MMR impact leader cards show a muted '(still loading)' caption, because leaders can change as pages arrive.
- Replace the raw 'Could not load opponents — {json}' (:338-342) with a role=alert banner and a 'Try again' button that calls retry() (aria-busy, 'Retrying…'). Use components/ui/RequestError.tsx if data-states-recovery has landed; otherwise mirror OpponentReplayHistory.tsx:99-118. This pack takes over data-states-recovery's 'OpponentsTab L340' migration line.
- Stale refresh with rows still visible: a slim inline warning 'Couldn't refresh after your last game. Showing the list from before.' with Try again, instead of replacing the table.

3) Performance (list-performance)
- Use const deferredSearch = useDeferredValue(search) for the filter at :228-232. The input stays immediate, and the tbody is dimmed (opacity-70, aria-busy) while search !== deferredSearch.
- Memo the sorted array on [filtered, sort.col, sort.dir] (:244-247).
- Windowed render: show the first 200 sorted rows (groups count as one in grouped mode), plus a 'Show 200 more (of 3,412)' button under the table that keeps focus. Reset the window to 200 when search, sort, min games, MMR impact or grouping change. Do NOT reset it when a dbRev refresh swaps items or more pages stream in. Counts and the status line always use the full filtered total.
- Extract the row JSX (:460-537) into React.memo OpponentRow({row, expanded, onToggle, onOpen}) with useCallback handlers, so expanding one alias group re-renders one row.

Edge cases: a user with 0 opponents (no skeleton loop, the empty state shows); a fetch abort on unmount is not shown as an error; 8-page cap behaviour unchanged.

Tests (vitest + RTL, fetch mocked):
- hook: a dbRev change keeps items and sets isRefreshing; a userId change clears; a cold load publishes after page 1 and sets isLoadingMore; a JSON error body gives friendly copy and keeps the code; retry() refetches; a failed refresh keeps items with isStale; a double dbRev bump aborts the first loop.
- OpponentsTab: no skeleton while refreshing with rows; the error banner's Try again calls retry; 450 rows render 200 plus 'Show 200 more'; the window resets on search change and is kept on refresh.

Dependencies:
- Same wave as data-states-recovery. Land after it, or ship the local banner and let it swap in RequestError.
- realtime-one-connection (wave 2) later debounces dbRev bumps. This pack is still required because each bump would otherwise blank the table.
- opponents-list-mobile-rivals (wave 3) must render its mobile cards from the same windowed, memoised list.
audit_findings:
- Stop the opponents table blanking on every new replay; render pages progressively; readable error with retry (states)
- Deferred search and windowed rendering for large opponent histories (performance)

title: Votes you can trust, honest reports, and a safe author page
spec:
Goal: close the stored-XSS hole on author profiles and make every vote-related number truthful.

1) Author JSON-LD XSS (security, ship first). In apps/web/components/community/AuthorProfile.tsx (around lines 46-51), replace JSON.stringify(personJsonLd) with serializeJsonLd(personJsonLd) from apps/web/lib/reviewJsonLd.ts. Add a test to apps/web/components/community/__tests__/AuthorProfile.test.tsx, copied from the hostile-title test in app/community/builds/[slug]/page.test.tsx (lines 65-74). Use displayName = '</script><script>alert(1)</script>' and assert that the ld+json script body contains no '</script' and no raw '<'. Add a guard test, apps/web/lib/__tests__/jsonLdSafety.test.ts. It globs apps/web/app/**/*.tsx and apps/web/components/**/*.tsx, finds every 'application/ld+json' script, and fails if the matching __html uses JSON.stringify instead of serializeJsonLd.

2) Votes API (apps/api/src/services/community.js, vote() at about line 1352; apps/api/src/routes/community.js at about line 298).
- vote(userId, slug, delta) accepts delta 1, -1 or 0, where 0 clears your vote. Any other value is a 400 with 'delta must be -1, 0 or 1'.
- Make the write atomic with one aggregation-pipeline update on {slug, removed:false}:
  - upvotes = $setUnion or $setDifference with [userId], depending on delta
  - downvotes the same, mirrored
  - votes = $subtract of $size(upvotes) and $size(downvotes)
  This removes today's read-then-write race on the cached count.
- If no build matched, return 404 build_not_found.
- Return {votes, myVote, changed}. changed is true only when the stored vote differed. notification-center (wave 2) should fire its community.vote producer only when changed && myVote === 1.
- The route responds 200 with {votes, myVote} instead of 204.
- New method myVote(userId, slug) and route GET /community/builds/:slug/my-vote (deps.auth). It returns {votes, myVote: 1|-1|0}, sends Cache-Control 'private, no-store', and returns 404 for missing or removed builds.

3) Vote panel (apps/web/components/community/CommunityVotePanel.tsx plus a new apps/web/components/community/useCommunityVote.ts).
- useCommunityVote(slug, initialVotes) seeds from useApi(`/v1/community/builds/${slug}/my-vote`) when signed in. The live count also corrects a stale SSR count once caching lands.
- It exposes {votes, myVote, cast(next), pending, error}. cast() sends delta 0 when next === myVote, which undoes the vote. The optimistic score is votes - myVote + next, then replaced by the server's {votes, myVote}; on error it rolls back. community-polish-4 reuses this hook for the mobile action row.
- Upvote and Downvote become toggle buttons with aria-pressed. The active one is filled (success tone for up, danger tone for down).
- Under the buttons, show 'You upvoted · Undo' or 'You downvoted · Undo'. Undo is a text button.
- Status messages are split by tone:
  - Errors: AlertTriangle icon, text-danger, role=alert. 429 → 'You're voting too fast. Try again in a minute.' 401 → 'Your session expired. Sign in again.' 404 → 'This build was removed.'
  - Success: role=status, no CheckCircle on errors.
- The signed-out link 'Sign in to vote or report' uses a new apps/web/lib/authLinks.ts with signInHref(returnTo) = `/sign-in?redirect_url=${encodeURIComponent(returnTo)}`, the same mechanism /reviews uses today. auth-return-to-context (wave 5) later hardens this helper with safeReturnPath and does not replace call sites. community-polish-2 and community-polish-5 reuse it.

4) Report form, in the same panel.
- A fieldset with legend 'Why are you reporting this build?' and radio options. Each option sends its label as `reason`, so the admin queue stays readable without admin changes:
  - 'Spam or advertising'
  - 'Offensive or abusive'
  - 'Broken or wrong steps'
  - 'Copied without credit'
- An optional 'Add details (optional)' textarea, maxLength 280, with a live '0/280' counter, sent as `note`. The API already accepts note up to 1000 characters.
- Submit stays disabled until a category is picked.
- The response's alreadyReported flag decides the copy: true → 'You've already reported this build — thanks.' false → 'Thanks — a moderator will review this build.'

5) Controversial sort (_listControversial at about line 1201).
- In $addFields: up = $size(ifNull upvotes []), down likewise, total = up + down, minV = $min, maxV = $max.
- controversy = cond(total >= 4 && minV > 0, $pow(total, minV / maxV), 0).
- Sort {controversy:-1, minV:-1, total:-1, publishedAt:-1}. Builds below the threshold still list after the controversial ones. A +40/−0 build no longer tops the list.
- Keep PUBLIC_AGGREGATE_PROJECTION last, so up, down and controversy are never returned.
- In apps/web/components/community/types.ts, set the hint to 'Close split of up and down votes (4+ votes)'. Show the selected sort's hint as a caption under the sort Select in CommunityFilterBar.tsx, linked with aria-describedby, because the option title tooltip is hover-only.

Dependencies: builds-correctness-fixes (wave 1) edits builds/[slug]/page.tsx and SaveToLibraryButton. This pack avoids page.tsx; the panel seeds itself client-side. notification-center (wave 2) builds on the {changed} return value.

Edge cases:
- Double-click while pending is ignored.
- Signed-out users never call /my-vote.
- A build removed between page load and click returns 404 and shows the removed copy.
- Votes on your own build are allowed, as today.

Tests:
- API (apps/api/__tests__/communityAndGdpr.test.js or a new communityVotes.test.js):
  - three upvotes give +1
  - switching up to down moves the score by −2
  - delta 0 clears the vote
  - delta 2 returns 400
  - a removed slug returns 404
  - my-vote returns 1, -1 or 0
  - the route body is {votes, myVote}
  - controversial ordering fixture [+5/−5, +3/−2, +1/−1, +40/−0] comes back in that order
- Web (new apps/web/components/community/__tests__/CommunityVotePanel.test.tsx):
  - aria-pressed reflects myVote
  - clicking the active button sends delta 0
  - the displayed count is the server value
  - an error renders role=alert with the danger tone
  - alreadyReported copy
  - submit disabled until a category is chosen
  - note capped at 280 characters
- AuthorProfile and jsonLdSafety tests as described in step 1.

  - stockMarket.tsx (components/analyzer/arcade/modes/games/stockMarket.tsx) sends settled:true from the settle POST (about line 225) and settled:false from the lock-in POST (about line 328).
  - listLeaderboard(weekKey, {limit, userId}) becomes an aggregate over the existing {weekKey, pnlPct, updatedAt} index:
    - $addFields settled = (settled === true) OR (pnlPct != 0), because legacy non-zero rows count as settled
    - $sort {settled:-1, pnlPct:-1, updatedAt:1}
    - $limit (default 50, max 200)
  - Rows get rank (settled rows only; unsettled rows get rank null), settled and isYou (r.userId === userId). Strip userId before returning, and never return it.
  - The response adds participants (countDocuments {weekKey}) and settledCount.
  - It also adds you: {rank, pnlPct, settled} or null. rank = 1 + count of settled rows with a higher pnlPct, or an equal pnlPct and an earlier updatedAt, so it works outside the top N.

title: Guide outage states with a real 'Try again', and CTAs that know you are signed in
spec:
Two problems show on every guide page: outage states give no working next step, and signed-in players are asked to sign up.

A) Outage states that can recover (unavailable-retry)
1. apps/web/components/guides/GuideRetryButton.tsx (new, 'use client') renders a primary 'Try again' button. On click it calls startTransition(() => router.refresh()). While the transition is pending, the button is disabled with aria-busy=true and a Loader2 icon spinning under motion-safe:animate-spin. Double clicks are ignored while pending.
2. apps/web/components/guides/GuideStates.tsx GuideUnavailable gains props {onRetry?: () => void; variant?: 'page' | 'hub'}.
- Description copy: 'The stats service didn't respond. This usually clears within a minute.'
- Action row: the primary is 'Try again', either GuideRetryButton or a plain button calling onRetry when it is passed.
- variant 'page' keeps the secondary 'All build guides' (/guides).
- variant 'hub' drops the self-link. Its secondaries are 'Open your dashboard' (/app) and 'Home' (/).
3. apps/web/app/guides/error.tsx accepts {error, reset}. It passes onRetry={() => startTransition(() => { router.refresh(); reset(); })} (the Next 15 recovery pattern). It keeps the noindex meta and the console.warn digest log.
4. apps/web/app/guides/page.tsx renders <GuideUnavailable variant='hub' title='Build guides are temporarily unavailable'/>. The maps outage (app/guides/maps/page.tsx) and the videos outage (app/guides/videos/page.tsx) get the same Try again.
5. Edge cases:
- ISR build, counter and map pages throw GuideUnavailableError into error.tsx, so reset plus refresh refetches the RSC payload. If the API is still down, the same state re-renders with no loop, because retry only runs on click.
- Keep the 200 + noindex semantics.
6. If help-and-feedback-menu (roadmap wave 1) has merged, add a tertiary 'Report a problem' link that opens its modal. If it hasn't, omit the link (no stub).

B) CTAs that know about sign-in (signed-in-aware-ctas)
1. apps/web/components/guides/GuideCtas.tsx is already a client component; it now reads useAuth().
- While !isLoaded, or when signed out, it renders today's markup unchanged: 'Track your win rate with this build — free' → /sign-up. ISR HTML and crawlers see the same thing, and the button classes are identical, so there is no layout shift.
- Signed in: the primary is 'See your record with this build', an in-page link to #your-record. That id already exists on the Section in BuildTimingsSection.tsx:132. Scroll smoothly only when prefers-reduced-motion is off. The secondary is 'Open my builds' → /app/builds.
- The GA event guide_cta_click gets cta values 'record' | 'my-builds' | 'upload' alongside the existing ones.
2. The GuideNotEnoughGames sign-up button (GuideStates.tsx:71) moves into a tiny client island, GuideAuthCta. Signed out, it keeps 'Sign up free and track your games' → /sign-up. Signed in, it shows 'Upload more games' → /download.
3. apps/web/components/guides/GuidePersonalComparison.tsx
- SignInPrompt links to guideSignInHref(usePathname()), which produces /sign-in?redirect_url=%2Fguides%2Fpvz%2Fx.
- The signed-in empty state's 'upload a few games' becomes a link to /download.
4. apps/web/components/guides/guideAuthLinks.ts (new) exports guideSignInHref(path).
- It accepts only ^/guides(/[a-z0-9-]+){0,3}$: no query, no fragment, no '//', no '..', no encoded characters. Anything else returns '/sign-in'.
- This relies on Clerk 6.9.5 SignIn's native redirect_url handling (same-origin only). That is the mechanism components/reviews/MyReviews.tsx:42 and ReviewPage.tsx:338 already use. app/sign-in only forces a redirect for the /try value.
- Do NOT widen safeAuthRedirect (lib/instant/authRedirect.ts): sign-up must keep routing new accounts through /welcome. Returning new sign-ups to the guide belongs to roadmap auth-return-to-context (wave 5, /welcome?next=). That item will replace guideSignInHref with lib/authLinks signInHref, so leave a comment pointing at it.

title: Public profile and replay pages survive share traffic, return real 404s and never dead-end
spec:
Goal: a viral link to /p/<handle> or /players/<slug>/replays never 404s a real page, never caches an outage, and never leaves the visitor stuck. Lands in wave 1 alongside visitor-dead-ends. Coordinate with it: if it lands first, reuse its auth-aware not-found actions island and its CloudOff outage panel. Neither blocks the other. public-player-page (wave 5) later replaces /p/[handle] with /players/[player] and must keep every rule below (recorded in that item's augment).

1) Profile fetch and status codes (profile-404-under-load). In apps/web/app/p/[handle]/page.tsx, fetchProfile calls getJsonWithStatus(path, { revalidateSec: 300 }) so the documented ISR window actually caches. lib/serverApi.ts already supports this; only its doc comment changes. Wrap fetchProfile in React cache() so generateMetadata and the page share one request. Only status === 404 calls notFound(). For 429, any 5xx and null (unreachable), throw a PublicFetchError(status) from both generateMetadata and the page instead of rendering a 200 noindex page. Why throw: a thrown render is never stored in the ISR cache; Next keeps serving the last good page when a background revalidation throws; and a first-time visitor gets a 5xx, which crawlers treat as temporary, whereas a 200 noindex can de-index the profile. A rendered 'unavailable' page under revalidate=300 would be cached for 5 minutes. New app/p/[handle]/error.tsx ('use client') renders the unified unavailable state from step 3, with Try again calling reset() and then router.refresh(). Next 15 writes only 200 responses to the data cache, so a 429/5xx is never replayed. Rewrite the page's header comment to match. In apps/api/src/routes/publicProfile.js, add keyGenerator `${req.ip}:${String(req.params.handle || '').toLowerCase()}`, mirroring publicReplays.js:53-54, so one hot profile cannot exhaust every other profile's 60/min budget on the shared Next egress IP.

2) Archive cursor and busy states (archive-cursor-dead-end). In apps/web/app/players/[player]/replays/page.tsx, on status 400 with a cursor in the query, redirect to the same canonical URL with cursor (and page, once profiles-replays-polish-2 adds it) removed, keeping the filters and adding notice=page-expired. parseQuery accepts notice only as that literal value, and queryHref/replayListHref never re-emit it. PublicReplayLibrary renders an inline role=status notice above the list: 'That page link expired. Showing the newest replays.' (or 'oldest replays' when sort=date_asc), with a dismiss link to the URL without notice. A 400 without a cursor renders the unavailable state with no redirect, so it can never loop. A 429 renders the busy variant:
- Title 'Lots of visitors right now', body 'Try again in a few seconds.'
- An aria-live=polite countdown 'Retrying in 10…' that calls router.refresh().
- At most 3 automatic retries per URL. Keep the counter in sessionStorage inside try/catch; if storage is unavailable, retry once.
- Pause the countdown while document.hidden, show a manual Try again at all times, and use no animation under prefers-reduced-motion.
5xx and unreachable keep the outage copy and add 'Back to first page' (a link to the bare archive root) beside Try again whenever the URL has a cursor or filters. The detail page uses the same busy/outage split.

3) One unavailable component. Merge ProfileUnavailable.tsx and PublicReplayUnavailable.tsx into apps/web/components/public-profile/PublicUnavailable.tsx with props { surface: 'profile' | 'archive' | 'analysis', reason: 'busy' | 'outage', resetHref?: string }. Every variant has an sr-only h1, the CloudOff EmptyStatePanel and a Try again Button (router.refresh(), falling back to location.reload()). Titles: 'Profile temporarily unavailable', 'Replay archive temporarily unavailable', 'Replay analysis temporarily unavailable'. Update the imports and delete the two old files.

4) Shared analysis loading and a real 404 (public-states-skeleton-404). Move the analysis-shaped skeleton from app/p/[handle]/replays/[gameId]/loading.tsx to app/players/[player]/replays/[gameId]/loading.tsx, so opening a game no longer shows the list skeleton. Delete app/p/[handle]/replays/loading.tsx; the legacy routes only redirect and keep their redirect pages. In app/players/[player]/replays/[gameId]/page.tsx, wrap the apiFetch in a React cache() loader and call it from generateMetadata, raising notFound() there on a 404 so the status is a real 404, not a streamed 200. Middleware already requires sign-in, so the authenticated fetch works. The page reuses the cached result and keeps its canonical-handle redirect. Add app/p/[handle]/not-found.tsx and app/players/[player]/replays/not-found.tsx (which also covers [gameId]). Both render a new apps/web/components/public-profile/PublicNotFound.tsx:
- Title 'This page is private or no longer shared'.
- Body 'The player may have turned off their public profile or replay sharing, or the link is mistyped.'
- Actions 'Browse community builds' (/community), 'Leaderboard' (/community/leaderboard) and 'Get your own page' (/). No 'Open dashboard'.
- GlowHalo styling as in app/not-found.tsx, and robots noindex.

5) One API call per archive view (archive-metadata-double-fetch). The archive page's generateMetadata takes searchParams, parses them with the same parseQuery, and calls the same React cache()-wrapped fetchReplays(player, query), so metadata and page share one API call. app/players/[player]/replays/opengraph-image.tsx calls /v1/public/replays/:handle?limit=1&fields=profile. apps/api/src/routes/publicReplays.js accepts fields=profile (only that literal) and returns { profile, items: [], page: { hasMore: false } } without shaping rows or resolving VODs.

Edge cases: legacy opaque ids still redirect to the canonical slug, with notice and cursor handled as above. A profile 404 stays indistinguishable from a private profile. The cursor-expired redirect always targets the canonical handle.

Tests:
- components/public-profile/__tests__/PublicProfilePage.test.tsx: add 429 and 500 cases (they throw PublicFetchError, not notFound). Keep the 404 case. Update the unreachable case, which now throws. Assert next.revalidate is 300 and there is one fetch per render.
- PublicReplays.test.tsx: 400 with a cursor redirects without the cursor and with notice; 400 without a cursor renders unavailable; 429 renders the busy copy and countdown (fake timers); the notice is not carried into pager links; metadata and page share one fetch; the detail generateMetadata raises notFound on 404.
- apps/api/__tests__/publicProfile.test.js: the limiter is per handle (61 hits on A give 429 while B still returns 200).
- apps/api/__tests__/publicReplaysRoute.test.js: fields=profile skips the VOD resolver.
- apps/web/tests/e2e/public-pages.spec.ts: /players/<missing>/replays returns a 404 with the new copy and no 'Open dashboard' link.
audit_findings:
- Stop public profiles 404ing under share traffic (rate limit + defeated ISR) (bug)
- Recover from stale or invalid page cursors and rate limits on the archive (bug)
- Fix shared-analysis loading/404 states and add a public-friendly not-found page (states)
- Stop the archive page making a second full API call just for metadata (performance)

spec:

with a ghost and the same copy, then swap. 1) Close request, which currently fails silently (ReviewPage.tsx RequestHeader.close, L243-252). Add catch(err) and setCloseError(err.message || "Couldn't close this request. Check your connection and try again."). Make them optimistic. Keep prev = me.data, then me.mutate({...prev,[key]:value},{revalidate:false}). On success, store the PATCH response and call onChanged(). On failure, run me.mutate(prev,{revalidate:false}) so the checkbox snaps back, and show role='alert' "Couldn't save that setting. Try again." under the checkboxes, cleared on the next toggle. Extract this into a useReviewerPrefs() hook in the same file so reviews-coaching-expansion-2 can reuse it. When me.error is set (today it returns null), show "Your reviewer settings couldn't load · Try again" (me.mutate()). 3) ReviewBoardLoader.tsx (admin rollout stage). Nothing was lost." and a 'Try again' button (req.mutate(), loading while req.isValidating). Replace the single h-40 pulse with 3 skeleton rows shaped like ReviewCard (h-24 rounded-xl border-2 border-line). 4) MyReviews.tsx, 'Reviews you've written' (L218 renders null). While !mine.data && !mine.error, show two h-20 skeleton rows (aria-busy). On mine.error, show the same error-with-Try-again (mine.mutate()) as the requests section. Upgrade the requests section's static 'Try again in a moment' (L199-200) to include a real Try again button. The 404 path is unchanged. 5) Map pin ownership (shared-draft-pin-bug). In ReviewPage, replace the shared draftPin and pinMode with draftPins: Record and pickingFor: owner | null, where owner is 'root' or the parent comment id. - onTogglePinMode(owner) sets or clears pickingFor. - onWorldClick writes draftPins[pickingFor] and clears pickingFor. - ThreadContext (ReviewThread.tsx) takes pinFor(owner), pickingFor, onTogglePinMode(owner) and onClearPin(owner). A reply composer uses owner = c.id. - Posting or cancelling a reply clears only its own pin (fixes L262 wiping the top-level pin). Top-level cancel and post clear only 'root'. - Map markers render each open draft's pin as '+'. - Pin chip copy (ReviewComposer.tsx L139): replace 'Pin at (123, 87)' with 'Pinned on map · becomes pin {pins.size+1}'. Keep the X button with aria-label 'Remove map pin'. - The pin-mode button reads 'Click the map to place the pin…' only in the composer that is picking. Tests (vitest + RTL in components/reviews/__tests__): - Close failure shows the alert, and Try again re-posts. - A toggle failure rolls the checkbox back and shows the alert. - The loader shows different copy for 404, 503 and a network error, and Retry calls mutate. - The written-reviews section shows its skeleton and error states. - With the root and a reply composer both open, a world click pins only the picking composer. - Posting the reply keeps the root pin. - The chip never shows coordinates.

title: Stream tools fail safely: overlays reconnect, dead links explain themselves, and the Dock never overwrites or loses your work
spec:
One PR covering how every streamer surface fails. Today an API blip can blank an OBS source until it is refreshed by hand, a revoked link looks like a quiet scene, and the Dock can wipe saved goals or b-roll, or throw away what the streamer typed.

A. Shared overlay socket (overlay-handshake-retry)
- Add createOverlaySocket(token, {surface:'all-in-one'|'widget'|'scene'|'dock', widget?, onStatus, ...existing handshake auth fields}) to apps/web/components/overlay/overlayResilience.ts, modelled on lib/useUserSocket.ts:65-86.
- On connect_error with err.message==='invalid_overlay_token', set status 'invalid', close the socket and stop retrying.
- Any other connect_error (overlay_unsupported, or an exception thrown by the resolver, which apps/api/src/socket/auth.js:197-199 forwards) calls socket.connect() again with capped exponential backoff: 1, 2, 4 … 30 s, ±20% jitter, reset on 'connect'. It also retries immediately on window 'online'.
- Status sequence: 'connecting' → 'connected' → 'reconnecting' (only after the existing 5 s debounce) → 'invalid' (terminal). Clear all timers and listeners on unmount. The socket must survive StrictMode double-mount without connecting twice.
- Use the helper in OverlayClient.tsx:370-381, OverlayWidgetClient.tsx:590-601, overlay/scenes/OverlaySceneClient.tsx:139-148 and lib/multichat/useStudioUpdates.ts:29-36. useStudioUpdates now also returns {status}. ReconnectDot now shows during a refused handshake.
- OverlaySceneClient also calls attachOverlayResilience, for resync and heartbeat.
- surface and widget are passed now so that overlay-presence-health (wave 4) only has to add them to the handshake auth. realtime-one-connection leaves overlay sockets alone.

B. Dead-link states (dead-link-states)
- New apps/web/components/overlay/OverlaySetupCard.tsx with reason 'invalid-token'|'unknown-widget'|'unknown-scene'. token-rotation (wave 4) will add 'replaced', so build the card to accept new reasons.
- Layout: max 360 px wide, bottom-left, overlay font. It never prints the token.
- Copy: title 'This overlay link no longer works', body 'It was revoked or mistyped. Copy a fresh URL from sc2tools.com → Settings → Overlay.'
- After 60 s the card collapses to a small 'Overlay link invalid' pill. It stays noticeable in the OBS preview without dominating a live stream.
- The three overlay clients render the card when status is 'invalid'.
- app/overlay/[token]/widget/[name]/page.tsx:283-292 and scene/[name]/page.tsx:351-360 replace the raw red list of every id with the card, for example 'There's no widget called "opponnent". Did you mean "opponent"?'. The suggestion comes from a small pure helper (Levenshtein ≤3 against the known widget ids or VALID_SCENES). With no close match, the card only points to Settings.
- ?check=1 on any overlay URL shows a badge in the top-left for 10 s, then hides it. States: 'Connected · waiting for a game', 'Connected · live game', 'Reconnecting…', 'Link invalid'.
- Dock: DockClient.tsx:99 and :238 treat a 401 invalid_overlay_token as terminal. They stop the studio retry loop (:258-261) and the platform-config fetch, then render a full-panel 'This Dock link no longer works' state with an 'Open Overlay settings' link to /settings?tab=overlay. This replaces the endless 'Loading chat settings…' (DockChat.tsx:238-239). The same panel shows when the socket reports 'invalid'. A non-terminal outage shows a one-line role=status 'Reconnecting to SC2 Tools…' under the Dock tabs; the global ConnectionBanner from data-states-recovery never renders on /dock.

C. Wait for the real snapshot (dock-wait-for-snapshot)
- Pass studioReady (DockClient.tsx:200-203) to DockScenes (including the Timer), DockPoll, DockGoals, DockClips and BrollLibraryEditor. DockChat and BuildProfileEditor already receive it.
- Until it is ready, each card shows a skeleton with role=status 'Loading your saved controls…' instead of default-state copy such as 'No goals yet' or 'Stream is live — no scene overlay', and every write action is disabled.
- After 15 s, the skeleton reads 'Still loading your saved controls — retrying…'.
- The guards also go inside the functions, not just on the disabled buttons. DockGoals save (DockGoals.tsx:208-217, 254-257), BrollLibraryEditor's full-list save and DockClient.blockUser (:413-416, which posts [...studio.blockedUsers, user]) all return early while not ready.

D. Keep input on a failed save (dock-keep-input-on-failed-save)
- postStudioAction (DockClient.tsx:341-343) returns postStudio's Promise<StudioState|null>, and the panels' onPost type changes to match.

title: Settings tabs you can trust: load-error states, no Pulse ID wipe, a safe game-history wipe, a mobile tab bar that shows where you are
spec:
ORDER / CONFLICTS: land after the wave-1 items data-states-recovery (provides components/ui/RequestError.tsx and QueryState, and migrates SettingsFoundation's error state itself), settings-quickwins (reworks SettingsMisc and SettingsShell hash handling) and app-shell-quick-fixes (SaveBar positioning, next/dynamic tabs). snapshots-safe-restore (wave 2) later rewrites the snapshot list and restore flow in SettingsBackups.tsx. This pack does NOT build snapshot labels, Download or Delete, which that item owns. It must keep this pack's date helper, From/Until validation and dryRun count. find-anything (wave 5) regroups the sidebar and must keep the mobile behaviour added here.

A) LOAD-ERROR STATES (no editable form over a failed load)
1. New apps/web/components/analyzer/settings/SettingsLoadError.tsx, a thin wrapper over RequestError modelled on BuildCheckInSettings.tsx:78-89. Title 'Couldn't load your <Tab> settings', the humanized message (by ClientApiError code), the line 'Your saved settings haven't changed.', and a 'Try again' button that calls mutate() with aria-busy while revalidating.
2. Rule for every tab: isLoading shows the existing skeleton. `error && data === undefined` shows SettingsLoadError and no inputs. A failed background revalidation while data exists keeps the form.
3. Profile (SettingsProfile.tsx:92-93,110): `serverDraft = data ? toDraft(data) : undefined`, so useDirtyForm never hydrates from DEFAULT_DRAFT. Today a failed load renders an empty editable form, and Save then PUTs pulseIds: [], wiping every saved Pulse ID. Add `hydrated` to useDirtyForm's result (components/ui/useDirtyForm.ts). The Profile save handler refuses to PUT unless hydrated is true (defence in depth).
4. Voice, Randomizer and Misc (SettingsVoice.tsx, SettingsRandomizer.tsx, SettingsMisc.tsx) render SettingsLoadError on a failed load. Today their edits never count as dirty and go nowhere without a message.
5. Foundation: check that data-states-recovery's migration uses the same component, with a retry instead of bare red text (SettingsFoundation.tsx:157-163). No duplicate work.
6. Backups (SettingsBackups.tsx:186, 207-212): when the snapshot list fails to load, show SettingsLoadError ('Couldn't load your snapshots') inside the Snapshots card instead of 'No snapshots yet'. Show the empty copy only when data has loaded with zero items. 'Take a snapshot' stays enabled.

B) SAFE GAME-HISTORY WIPE
1. New apps/web/lib/localDateRange.ts: `localDayStartIso('YYYY-MM-DD')` returns new Date(y, m-1, d).toISOString(), and `localNextDayStartIso` returns new Date(y, m-1, d+1). The API filter is date $gte since and $lt until (apps/api/src/services/gdpr.js wipeGames), so send since = local midnight of From and until = local midnight of the day after Until. The chosen Until day is then included. Today `new Date('YYYY-MM-DD')` is UTC midnight (SettingsBackups.tsx:138-145), and the Until day itself is excluded. Field labels: 'From' / 'Through (inclusive)', with the hint 'Dates use your local time'.
2. When both dates are set and From > Through, disable the delete button and show the inline error (role=alert): 'From must be on or before Through.' Server: POST /v1/me/games/wipe returns 400 bad_request 'since must be before until' when since >= until (apps/api/src/routes/me.js ~706).
3. Dry run: the same route accepts `dryRun: true` and returns {dryRun:true, counts:{games:N}} from countDocuments on the identical filter. Add gdpr.countGamesForWipe(userId,{since,until}) that shares the filter builder with wipeGames. It mutates nothing and takes no mutation fence.
4. Confirm dialog (SettingsBackups.tsx:311-336): fetch the dry run when it opens. Copy: 'This deletes 1,284 games from Oct 1 to Oct 15 (your time). Opponent records and macro data for those games go too. Custom builds, devices and overlay tokens are kept.' With no dates: 'This deletes all 12,431 games.' Confirm stays disabled while counting. Zero games shows 'No games in this range' and keeps confirm disabled. If the count fails, show 'Couldn't count the games in this range' and allow confirm.
5. Restore toast (SettingsBackups.tsx:79-81): restore is synchronous and returns counts (gdpr.js ~1215). Show 'Restored 3,402 games' from the response and delete the 'Restore queued… will swap once the job completes' copy.
6. After a wipe or restore, revalidate /v1/me, /v1/me/doctor and the analyzer SWR keys (global mutate with a key matcher) so game counts update without a reload.

C) MOBILE TAB BAR (SettingsShell.tsx:193-209, MobileTabTrigger 285-306)
1. Keep a ref to the active mobile trigger. On mount and whenever `active` changes, call scrollIntoView({inline:'nearest', block:'nearest'}): behavior 'auto' on first mount and when prefers-reduced-motion is set, 'smooth' otherwise. Guard against jsdom lacking scrollIntoView. A deep link such as ?tab=backups (used by app/legal/privacy/page.tsx:23) then shows its tab.
2. Left and right edge fades: wrap the scroller and update on scroll and through a ResizeObserver. Show a pointer-events-none gradient (from bg to transparent) only on a side where tabs are hidden.
3. Keyboard and ARIA matching the desktop Tabs.Trigger (components/ui/Tabs.tsx:148-175): roving tabIndex (active 0, others -1), ArrowLeft/ArrowRight wrap, Home/End, and activation through requestSwitch so the dirty guard still applies. Export a small helper from Tabs.tsx (e.g. useTabIds(value) → {triggerId, panelId}) so mobile triggers get id plus aria-controls pointing at the real panel id. Skip the audit's Select alternative.

TESTS: per tab (Profile, Voice, Randomizer, Misc, Backups), useApi {error, data: undefined} renders 'Try again' with no inputs, and clicking it calls mutate. Profile regression: a failed load can never PUT pulseIds: []. localDateRange under TZ=America/Los_Angeles: From Oct 1 gives 2025-10-01T07:00:00Z and Through Oct 15 gives 2025-10-16T07:00:00Z. From > Through disables delete. API: dryRun returns the count and deletes nothing, and since >= until returns 400. Mobile: ?tab=backups calls scrollIntoView on the Backups trigger; arrows move focus and activate; aria-controls matches the panel id.
audit_findings:
- Add a 'Couldn't load, Try again' state to every settings tab and stop Profile wiping data after a failed load (states)
- Make game-history deletion safe and give snapshots labels, delete and download (bug)
- Mobile settings tab bar: scroll to the active tab, show an edge fade, support arrow keys (mobile)
howto: Add a 'Deleting game history' section to the help article backups-and-export (apps/web/lib/help/articles/account-data.ts, written by help-content-backfill). It says dates are your local time and both days are included, the dialog shows how many games will be deleted, to take a snapshot first, and to re-sync from the desktop app afterwards. Load errors and the mobile tab bar need no docs.

title: Landing replay demo that works: real drag-and-drop, iPhone picking, recoverable errors, and one clear 'try it' path
spec:
Goal: the landing #replay-demo stops losing visitors. Today a dropped file navigates away, iOS can't pick a file, picking the same file again does nothing, and the error modal is a dead end. The hero should also stop offering two confusing 'try it' flows.

A. Drag-and-drop (apps/web/components/landing/ReplayDemo.tsx). Extract useDropTarget from components/instant/ReplayIntake.tsx:184 into components/instant/useDropTarget.ts, unchanged, and import it from both files. Attach its handlers to the whole demo card, not only ReplayDropPreview (539-571). Call preventDefault on dragover/drop only when event.dataTransfer.types includes 'Files', so text drags behave normally. The depth counter keeps the highlight steady when dragging over children. Highlight state: ring-2 ring-accent on the card plus an overlay 'Drop to analyze'. On drop, take the first file where isReplayFileName(name) (lib/instant/fileIntake.ts:96). If there is none, show an inline error 'That isn't a .SC2Replay file. Drop a replay from your StarCraft II Replays folder.' and make no request. If several replays were dropped, use the first and say 'Using <name>. The demo reads one replay at a time.' Ignore drops while a parse is in flight.

B. Picker. Export useReplayAccept from ReplayIntake.tsx:162 (it wraps replayInputAccept(navigator.userAgent, navigator.maxTouchPoints), fileIntake.ts:173) and use it in place of the hard-coded accept=".SC2Replay" (ReplayDemo.tsx:243). Because iOS gets a relaxed accept, validate with isReplayFileName after the pick. After reading the file, set event.currentTarget.value = '' (as ReplayIntake.tsx:317 does) so choosing the same file again fires change.

C. Parsing state: show '<file name> · <size>' (formatBytes or an equivalent helper) next to the progress.

D. DossierError (410-429) gets a footer. The primary Button 'Choose another replay' calls inputRef.current.click(). When getInstantImportMode()==='all' and the code is one of parse_failed, python_error, parser_no_output, extract_failed, parser_import_failed, preview_timeout, parser_overflow, preview_unavailable, replay_too_new or too_large, add a secondary 'Analyze it in your browser' link to /try. Wherever the message says 'Sign up' or mentions the agent, add a 'Create a free account' link to /sign-up. rate_limited keeps 'Choose another replay' with its 'wait a minute' copy. On open, move focus to the error heading (role=alert). Esc or close returns focus to the drop target. Style the links with the CtaLink or Button pill classes; ui-primitives-and-dialogs swaps them for LinkButton later.

E. One try path (apps/web/components/landing/LandingPageContent.tsx, HeroCtas 121-157). When the instant mode is 'all', remove the 'Try a replay' (#replay-demo) text link so the hero shows only Download (primary) and /try (secondary). With instant mode off, keep the current 'Try a replay' CtaLink.

F. Reposition and rename the demo. Move <ReplayDemo/> in the section order (37-55) from 9th place to directly after the Practice chapter, which pitches the build editor. Keep id='replay-demo' so old anchors still work. New kicker 'Build editor demo', headline 'Turn a replay into a custom build', subhead 'Drop one 1v1 replay and we open the build editor on your build order.' Add microcopy under the drop target: 'Drag a replay here or click to choose'.

G. Upload honesty. Next to the choose button add: 'Uploaded once to our server, parsed, then deleted.' followed by the existing PrivateTryLink ('Want it private? Analyze in your browser instead', shown only when instant mode is 'all'). Remove any wording that implies the file stays local.

It must keep the drop handler, accept hook, input reset and error footer from this pack, and replace line G with 'Runs in your browser. The replay never leaves your device.' landing-try-polish-2 (also wave 1) edits the hero grid and carousel in the same file but in different blocks. Land polish-2 first and rebase this pack. The shared useDropTarget extraction must keep ReplayIntake.test.tsx green.

Tests: new apps/web/components/landing/__tests__/ReplayDemo.test.tsx.
- dragEnter, dragOver and drop with a DataTransfer holding a .SC2Replay File call the upload exactly once; mock fetch.
- A dragLeave from a child does not clear the highlight.
- Dropping a .txt shows the inline error and makes no fetch.
- The input value is '' after change, and the same File chosen twice uploads twice.
- With an iPhone UA (maxTouchPoints 5), accept is not '.SC2Replay' and matches ReplayIntake's value.
- The preview_timeout error shows 'Choose another replay' and a /try link when getInstantImportMode is mocked 'all', and no /try link when it is off. rate_limited shows only 'Choose another replay'. Focus lands on the error heading.
LandingPageContent test: with instant mode 'all', the hero has no link to #replay-demo, and the demo section comes after the Practice chapter in DOM order.
audit_findings:

title: Landing hero that holds still on phones, an accessible carousel, and current product claims
spec:
Goal: first-time phone visitors see the headline and CTAs first, nothing jumps every 5.5 s, the carousel meets WCAG 2.2.2, 4.1.2 and 2.5.8, and public copy stops claiming unshipped or stale things.

A. Stable height (apps/web/components/landing/HeroCarousel.tsx:124-138). Make the slide list a `grid`, with every <li> at `col-start-1 row-start-1`. Inactive slides stay opacity-0 and aria-hidden and gain `inert`; drop absolute inset-0. The tallest slide then sets the height. Keep the fade and motion-reduce:transition-none.

B. Mobile order (LandingPageContent.tsx:107). Remove `order-first` from the carousel wrapper so that below lg the H1, paragraph, HeroCtas and trust strip render before the carousel. DOM order already matches.

C. Below md, use a swipe strip instead of autoplay. With CSS classes only (no JS media query, so there is no hydration mismatch), the list is `max-md:flex max-md:overflow-x-auto max-md:snap-x max-md:snap-mandatory max-md:gap-3`, and each slide is `max-md:snap-center max-md:w-[85%] max-md:shrink-0 max-md:opacity-100`, not inert below md. The autoplay effect starts only when matchMedia('(min-width: 768px)').matches. Dots and arrows are hidden below md.

D. Real product first slide. Replace the brand-art Banner slide (Banner.tsx:61-72 as used in LandingCarousel) with a product slide using public/landing/opponent-dna.png ('Opponent DNA: every opponent's openings and timings before the game'). Add public/landing/builds.png as a further slide. Use next/image with width, height and sizes to avoid CLS, and descriptive alt text. If Banner's hero variant becomes unused, delete that variant only.

- Add a Pause/Play toggle in the dot row (lucide Pause/Play, aria-label 'Pause slideshow' / 'Play slideshow', 44px target).

- Swipe on touch tablets: pointerdown/pointerup with |dx|>40 and |dx|>|dy| goes prev or next; set touch-action: pan-y.
- Left/Right keys work while focus is inside the carousel.
Keep the existing prefers-reduced-motion check (69-72). appearance-and-formats (wave 6) will later swap it for the shared useReducedMotion.

- US English: Replay Theatre to Replay Theater (LandingPageContent.tsx:334); practise to practice (94, 528); favour to favor (207); licence to license (app/legal/terms/page.tsx:69).

  - All slides render inside the same grid cell.

  - pointerdown/up with dx=-60 goes to the next slide.

title: Cookie choice you can change, legal pages that read well, and a crash screen that recovers
spec:
Goal: withdrawing analytics consent is as easy as giving it (GDPR), the banner works when storage is blocked, the legal pages render with real typography and navigation, and the root crash screen follows the theme and really recovers.

A. apps/web/lib/analytics/consent.ts.
- Add a module-level `let memoryConsent: ConsentState = 'unset'`. setConsent writes memoryConsent first, then tries localStorage. readConsent returns the stored value when storage works, else memoryConsent. A click now always takes effect for the session.
- Add openCookieSettings(), which dispatches 'sc2tools:open-cookie-settings'.
- Add withdrawConsent(): setConsent('denied'); set window['ga-disable-'+GA_MEASUREMENT_ID]=true; call gtag('consent','update',{analytics_storage:'denied'}) when window.gtag exists; delete the `_ga` and `_ga_<id without 'G-'>` cookies for path=/ on both the bare host and `.${hostname}` with an expired date.
- components/analytics/GoogleAnalytics.tsx calls the disable path on a granted to denied transition.
- settings-quickwins (wave 1) item 4 adds a Settings > Misc 'Analytics cookies' row. It must call withdrawConsent() and setConsent('granted') from here; whichever PR lands first adds these exports.

B. apps/web/components/CookieBanner.tsx.
- Visible when consent==='unset' or after the open-cookie-settings event (local `reopened` state).
- Reopened mode: title 'Cookie settings', a status line 'Analytics is currently on' or 'off', buttons 'Turn off analytics' (withdrawConsent) and 'Allow analytics', and a close X (Esc closes too). Focus moves into the panel on open and returns to the trigger on close.
- New copy. It keeps the essential presence cookie honest: components/chrome/SitePresence.tsx sets an HttpOnly visitor cookie for the 'players online' count. Copy: 'Essential cookies keep you signed in and count each browser once in players online. With your OK, Google Analytics shows us which features get used. No ads, no data selling. Privacy Policy'.
- Buttons use size 'md' (44px) and go full-width on mobile, replacing sm/h-9.

C. apps/web/components/chrome/Footer.tsx:50-51: add a 'Cookie settings' <button>, styled like the footer links, that calls openCookieSettings(). Hide it when !isAnalyticsConfigured().

D. New components/legal/LegalLayout.tsx (client-free server component). Props: {title, updated: ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD', summary?, sections: {id,title}[], children}.
- Render a token-styled H1 (existing type tokens, not raw text-3xl) and 'Last updated October 8, 2026' via one en-US formatter. Both pages store ISO dates (fixes 'August 11, 2026' vs '2026-10-08').
- 'On this page' table of contents built from sections: a sticky lg sidebar (lg:sticky lg:top-24) and a <details> on smaller screens.
- Each h2 gets id and a hover/focus-visible '#' anchor link (aria-label 'Link to section: <title>').
- max-w-prose body spacing. Links use text-accent, underline-offset-2, hover:text-accent-hover and a focus-visible ring. Internal links use next/link (privacy:80-85 settings link).
- Remove `prose prose-invert`: tailwind.config.ts:149 has no typography plugin, and prose-invert would break light mode.
- Add an @media print block that hides header, footer, TOC and cookie banner, sets black text, and appends external URLs.

E. app/legal/privacy/page.tsx and app/legal/terms/page.tsx migrate onto LegalLayout with all 13 privacy sections keyed by id. Privacy adds a 'The short version' box at the top: 4-5 bullets condensed only from existing sections (what we collect, what we never do, analytics is opt-in, how to delete your account, how to contact us), with no new claims. The Cookies section (417-436) gets id='cookies', a <CookieSettingsButton/> client island (components/legal/CookieSettingsButton.tsx) and the sentence 'You can change your choice any time from Cookie settings here or in the site footer.'. Move ISSUES_URL (privacy:21, terms:130) into lib/siteLinks.ts. The visitor-dead-ends error.tsx augment reuses it too. contrast-tokens-and-a11y-gate (wave 5) adds app/legal/accessibility/page.tsx, and it should use LegalLayout.

F. apps/web/app/global-error.tsx. Keep inline styles, because globals.css is not guaranteed inside global-error.
- Add a <style> defining CSS variables for dark (default), under @media (prefers-color-scheme: light), and under [data-theme=light]/[data-theme=dark]. Add a tiny inline <script> that reads localStorage 'sc2tools.theme' in try/catch and sets data-theme on <html>.
- Buttons: 'Try again' (reset()) and 'Reload page' (window.location.reload()). The current 'Reload page' calls reset() (56, 70), which usually re-throws.
- Add a plain <a href='/'> 'Go to home page'.
- When error.digest exists, show 'Error reference: <digest>' with a Copy button (clipboard, select-text fallback) and 'Report this problem' linking to `${ISSUES_URL}/new` with title and body prefilled with the digest and pathname (no query string).
- Keep captureException.

Tests:
- lib/analytics/__tests__/consent.test.ts: with localStorage.setItem and getItem throwing, setConsent('denied') makes readConsent() return 'denied'. withdrawConsent removes _ga cookies from document.cookie and sets the ga-disable flag.
- components/__tests__/CookieBanner.test.tsx: hidden after Accept with storage blocked. openCookieSettings() shows 'Cookie settings' with the current state. Esc closes and returns focus. Buttons are not size sm.
- Footer test: the button renders only when analytics is configured.
- components/legal/__tests__/LegalLayout.test.tsx: the TOC lists every section id, each h2 has an id, the date is formatted, and no 'prose' class remains.
- app/__tests__/global-error.test.tsx: Reload calls window.location.reload (mocked), Try again calls reset, Copy writes the digest, and the theme script is present.
- Playwright public-pages.spec.ts: /legal/privacy at 360px has no horizontal scroll and a TOC link scrolls to #cookies.
audit_findings:
- Let visitors change their cookie choice, and stop the banner sticking when storage is blocked (bug)
- Legal pages: one shared layout with a table of contents, section anchors and design-token typography (ui-cleanliness)
- Global error screen: follow the theme, make "Reload page" really reload, and add a way home (states)
howto: Add a help article 'Privacy & cookies' (slug privacy-cookies) in apps/web/lib/help/articles/account-data.ts, following the help-center-foundation convention, so it renders at /help/privacy-cookies and in Settings > Help (/settings?tab=help#privacy-cookies). It explains what the banner controls (only Google Analytics), how to change the choice (footer 'Cookie settings', the Privacy Policy Cookies section, the Settings > Misc 'Analytics cookies' row), and that blocked site data means you will be asked again each visit. If help-center-foundation has not landed yet, add the same text as a HelpSection in apps/web/components/analyzer/settings/SettingsHelp.tsx. The privacy policy's Cookies section itself names the Cookie settings control. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.

title: Context bar: one h1 per page, a back button that matches its label, breadcrumbs, and visible navigation progress
spec:
Problem (verified in code): AppChrome sets ownsHeading = match?.entry.group !== 'utility', so detail pages get two h1s: the bar plus ProfileView.tsx:269 or GameDetailShell's matchup-on-map h1. On /app/game the chevron reads 'Back to Replay' (surfaceTitle) but links to /app, while the in-page link goes to the opponent or reads 'Back to dashboard'. Community sub-routes have no loading.tsx. title: Moderation queue: confirm removals, show failures, group reports and show their context
spec:
Most dangerous admin gap. 'Remove target' fires instantly and failures are silent. Builds only on existing primitives (PageHeader, Button, ConfirmDialog, which already has a children slot, Field, EmptyStatePanel), so it does not depend on any roadmap item. ops-console (W2) will later add audit() to the resolve route; there is no web conflict.

Web, apps/web/app/admin/moderation/page.tsx:
1) Remove confirmation. Remove opens ConfirmDialog intent='danger', titled 'Remove this {build|comment|review|opponent}?'. The body shows the target title and snippet (item.target), the consequence line for that target type (reuse the current header copy, e.g. 'Takes it down for good; the author loses 20 review karma'; for builds, 'Unpublishes the build from Community'), and a 'Resolution note (optional)' textarea (max 500 characters, with a counter). The note is sent as `note`. Nothing is sent before the admin confirms.
2) Dismiss stays one click. Each card has a collapsed 'Add note' textarea, and its value is sent as `note` with both Dismiss and Remove (Remove pre-fills the dialog's textarea from it).
3) Errors. resolve() gets a catch, so there are no unhandled rejections. A failed action shows a dismissible role=alert inside that card: 'Couldn't remove: {message} · Error ID {requestId}', with Retry re-running the same action and note. A 404 report_not_found (another admin already resolved it) counts as success: refresh, and toast 'Already resolved'.
4) Per-row busy. Replace the global `busy` with busyKey = `${targetType}:${targetId}`. Hand-rolled buttons become Button (secondary Dismiss, danger Remove) with `loading` on the clicked action only. Other cards stay usable.
5) Grouping. Group open reports client-side by targetType+targetId into one card. The header shows the target title, a type badge, '3 reports · spam ×2, abuse ×1' and the age of the oldest report. An expandable list shows each report's reason, note, reporter and time.
6) Context links. Build targets link to /community/builds/{targetId}, opponent targets to /community/opponents/{targetId}, and registered targets use target.link. These open in a new tab with sr-only '(opens in new tab)'. Each reporter links to /admin/users/{reporterUserId}. A target with no description shows 'Target no longer exists' and can still be dismissed.
7) Filter and sort. A chip row by target type (All plus the types present, each with a count and aria-pressed), and a Sort Select: Oldest first (default), Newest first, Most reported.
8) Cap banner. When the response has capped=true, show 'Showing the oldest 100 of {total} open reports. Resolve these to see the rest.'
9) Header and empty state. PageHeader (eyebrow 'Admin', title 'Moderation queue' in loading, error and loaded states, fixing the :76 vs :98 mismatch) with one line of description, 'Dismiss keeps the content; Remove takes it down.', a <details> 'How moderation works' (auto-hide at 3 reports, karma penalty, notes are recorded), and a Refresh action. The empty queue uses EmptyStatePanel: 'Queue clear', 'No open reports. Last checked {time}.', action Refresh.

API:
- services/community.js listReports() also returns total = countDocuments({resolvedAt:null}) and capped = total > 100.
- resolveReport() settles every open report on the same targetType+targetId for every target type, not only registered ones (reuse the updateMany at :1645 for builds and opponents too). That way one decision clears the whole group. It returns {resolved: n}. The route POST /v1/community/admin/reports/:id is unchanged and accepts any report id in the group.

Tests:
- New apps/web/app/admin/moderation/page.test.tsx:
  - Remove opens the dialog and makes no request until confirmed.
  - The note is posted.
  - A failure renders the alert, and Retry re-posts.
  - Only the clicked card shows loading.
  - Grouping counts and reason tallies are correct.
  - The cap banner appears.
  - The empty state appears.
- apps/api/__tests__/communityAndGdpr.test.js:
  - Resolving one report on a build target settles all of that target's open reports.
  - listReports returns total and capped.

title: Settings you can trust: wheel guard, honest Save message, resettable API address, remembered window
spec:
Scope: four small fixes to the existing desktop window. No roadmap item touches them before wave 6. agent-settings-and-first-run (wave 6) later moves these controls into ui/settings_page.py and an Advanced group, and must keep the helpers added here: _show_settings_toast, validate_api_base, install_wheel_guard/guard_value_widgets and _go_to_page. Merge before agent-gui-polish-2, because both edit gui.py.

1) Save message is accurate and survives (save-toast-overwrite)
- apps/agent/sc2tools_agent/ui/gui.py: add MainWindow._show_settings_toast(text, tone='info'|'success'|'error', ms=6000), backed by ONE QTimer (self._settings_toast_timer, single-shot, restarted on every call) that clears self._settings_status. Tone sets objectName settingsToastOk / settingsToastErr, coloured _SUCCESS / _DANGER in the global QSS.
- Route every direct self._settings_status.setText plus QTimer.singleShot clear through the helper (gui.py:2686, 2917-2922, 2927, 2969-2979, 3002-3015, 3150-3160), so an older timer can never wipe a newer message.
- _click_save_settings (gui.py ~2880-2928): set self._save_ack = False before ui._on_save_settings(payload); _on_settings_status sets it to True. If it is still False after the call, show the local baseline 'Saved.' in success tone. Delete the false 'Saved · changes apply on next start'. If log level, parse concurrency or API address differ from the loaded values, append e.g. ' Log level and API address change after you restart SC2 Tools.', naming only the fields that changed.
- runner.py:1544-1568: rephrase the apply summary for users. Plain save: 'Saved.' With a filter change: 'Saved. Syncing Season 67 only; 12 queued uploads skipped; 40 older replays will sync again.' Pluralise each part and leave out parts that are zero. The failure path (gui.py:2927) uses error tone: 'Couldn't save settings: <reason>'.
- Fix the upload-batch tooltip (gui.py:1904-1911). Replace 'Takes effect on next agent restart' with 'Applies to the next batch.' The runner hot-swaps the batch size (runner.py:1367-1378).
- Tests:
  - apps/agent/tests/test_gui.py (offscreen): a fake _on_save_settings that synchronously calls gui.show_settings_status('Saved. Syncing Season 67 only…') leaves that text visible after Save. A no-op handler gives 'Saved.'. A first toast's timer firing does not clear a second toast shown later.
  - tests/test_runner_save_settings.py: assert the new phrasing and pluralisation.

2) API address can be reset and is checked (api-base-reset)
- gui.py:2864: send self._api_input.text().strip().rstrip('/'), using an empty string rather than None when blank. runner.py:1324-1325 already maps '' to None (the default), so a blank field now resets it. Include api_base in the payload only when it differs from the loaded value.
- New ui/qt_helpers.py with a Qt-free validate_api_base(text) -> Optional[str]:
  - '' is OK.
  - https with a host is OK.
  - http is OK only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1.
  - Anything else returns 'Enter a full address starting with https://, or leave it blank to use sc2tools.com.'
- Show the error inline under the field (objectName fieldError) on editingFinished and on Save. Save aborts with the error toast 'Fix the API address before saving.' and focuses the field.
- Next to the field add:
  - 'Reset to default': clears the field; the placeholder shows the default URL.
  - 'Test': GET {url or default}/v1/health (apps/api/src/routes/health.js) on a QThreadPool runnable with a 5 s timeout. Shows 'Reachable · 142 ms', or 'Couldn't reach that address (timeout / HTTP 503 / name not found)'. The button is disabled while running, and a result is ignored if the text changed since the test started.
- Add a muted 'Needs restart' tag after the label. The 'Restart now' button comes with agent-settings-and-first-run, which owns the relaunch path.
- Tests: a validate_api_base table (blank, https host, http localhost, http remote host, 'sc2tools.com' with no scheme, ftp://). test_runner_save_settings.py: api_base='' clears state.api_base_override. GUI test: a blank field sends '' and an unchanged field sends None.

3) The mouse wheel never edits a setting by accident (settings-wheel-guard)
- Move _WheelGuard from ui/streams_page.py:18-26 into ui/qt_helpers.py as install_wheel_guard(widget, QtCore). It sets Qt.StrongFocus and installs one shared event filter that ignores Wheel events while the widget lacks focus, so the QScrollArea scrolls instead. streams_page.py imports it, with no behaviour change there.
- Add guard_value_widgets(root), called once after the Settings tab, Build check-in group and OBS card are built. It walks findChildren for QComboBox, QAbstractSpinBox and QAbstractSlider. That covers:
  - the sync range combo (gui.py:1958-1981) and its date edits (1968-1977)
  - the log level combo (2000-2002)
  - the six OBS scene combos (2318-2324)
  - both sliders (1708-1719, 1891-1900)
  - the debounce spinbox (2347-2352)
  - any future control
- Keep ObsPortSpinBox's always-ignore behaviour; tests/test_gui_obs_port.py must still pass.
- Edge cases: an open combo popup still scrolls its own list. Arrow keys still work on a focused control. Clicking a control and then wheeling changes it, which is intended.
- Tests: new apps/agent/tests/test_gui_settings_wheel.py, modelled on test_gui_obs_port.py. For each guarded widget: a QWheelEvent while unfocused leaves the value unchanged and moves the scroll area; after setFocus the wheel changes the value.

4) The window remembers its size, position and page (window-state-persist)
- state.py: add window_geometry: Optional[str] (base64 of saveGeometry) and window_page: Optional[str]. The page is a key ('dashboard', 'recent', 'log', 'settings', 'streams'), not an index, so reordering pages stays safe. from_dict/to_dict coerce junk values to None.
- gui.py: add _PAGE_KEYS and _go_to_page(key). It sets the stack index AND checks the matching nav button; today nav buttons call _stack.setCurrentIndex directly (gui.py:1215). Route nav clicks through it.
- moveEvent, resizeEvent and page changes restart a 1 s debounce timer that calls a new ui._on_window_state(geometry_b64, page_key). The runner persists it with the existing state save. Skip saving while the window is minimized or hidden.
- Restore in __init__ after resize(960, 640):
  - restoreGeometry, then clamp the frame rect with build_checkin_window.clamp_card_position(point, size, [each screen's availableGeometry], min_visible=120).
  - If that returns None, centre the window on the primary screen at 960×640. Shrink the size to the target screen's available area if needed.
  - Restore the last page, except that an unpaired agent always opens on Dashboard.
- Tests: new tests/test_gui_window_state.py: round trip; a saved x=5000 with one fake 1920×1080 screen ends up on-screen; unpaired gives dashboard; an unknown page key gives dashboard. test_state.py: junk values are coerced.

Compatibility: none of this changes upload behaviour, and agent.json files without the new keys load unchanged.

- Stop overwriting the Save summary with a wrong "applies on next start" message (bug)
- Let a blank API base URL actually reset to the default, and guard the field (bug)

It should say the field is only for self-hosted or development setups; leave it blank or click Reset to default to go back to sc2tools.com; Test checks the address; the change applies after restarting SC2 Tools. 1) Activity log you can use during a sync (activity-log-usable). Code today: gui.py _build_logs_tab (1590-1628), _tail_log_now/_render_log (3429-3459), _matches_level (3491-3509).
- New Qt-free module apps/agent/sc2tools_agent/ui/log_records.py:
  - LogRecord(level, lines) and parse_chunk(carry, text) -> (records, new_carry).
  - A line matching ^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+ (DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL)\b starts a record. Any other line (traceback, wrapped JSON) belongs to the previous record.
  - A trailing partial line is carried to the next tick; today a half-written line is split in two.
  - matches(record, filter) replaces _matches_level, so 'Errors only' keeps the whole traceback.
- Keep records in deque(maxlen=3000); today the cap is MAX_LOG_LINES=800 lines.
- Render by appending only new matching records through a dedicated QTextCursor at the end of the document, with a QTextCharFormat per level: ERROR/CRITICAL _DANGER, WARNING amber, DEBUG _TEXT_MUTED, INFO default. Never call setPlainText on a tick, so the user's selection, caret and horizontal scroll stay put. Rebuild only when the filter changes. setMaximumBlockCount(6000).
- Seeding: the first tail seeks to max(0, size - 256 KB), skips to the next newline and shows a dim first line: '… older entries are in the log file - Open log folder'. Any later tick that finds more than 1 MB of new data does the same, so waking from sleep never freezes the GUI thread. Rotation (size < offset) keeps today's reset to 0.
- 'Follow new lines' toggle, on by default:
  - It turns off when the user scrolls up more than 4 px from the bottom or selects text.
  - While off, a pill shows '37 new lines - Jump to latest'; clicking it scrolls to the end and turns follow back on.
  - Reaching the bottom also turns it back on.
- Search: a 'Search log' box in the toolbar with a match count ('3 of 17').
  - A window-level Ctrl+F QShortcut calls _go_to_page('log') and focuses the box.
  - Enter or F3 goes to the next match, Shift+Enter or Shift+F3 to the previous one, Esc clears.
  - Case-insensitive QTextDocument.find; every hit is highlighted with ExtraSelections, and the current hit is scrolled into view, which also pauses follow.
- Copy tool-button menu: 'Copy selection' (disabled when nothing is selected) and 'Copy last 200 lines' (of the current filtered view). The button shows 'Copied ✓' for 2 s, like _copy_pairing_code. Ctrl+C keeps working.
- Filter labels become 'Everything', 'Info and above', 'Warnings and errors' and 'Errors only', with the same meaning as today.
- Public MainWindow.show_log(filter='errors', jump_to_last=True), used by agent-gui-polish-3 ('Open log' on the status card) and agent-pairing-recovery ('Open activity log' on the unreachable pairing state).
- Edge cases:
  - A missing or empty log shows the muted empty state 'Nothing logged yet'.
  - A file locked during rotation is retried on the next tick.
  - A search with no hits shows '0 matches'.
